title: Fractal phase structure of QCD under imaginary rotation
summary: We show that in hot QCD rotating at an imaginary angular velocity $Ω_I$, the angular velocity selects not only the temperature of the bulk but whether charge conjugation $C$ is broken there. For QCD at temperature $T$ and imaginary quark chemical potential $θ$, with $Ω_I/2π=p/q$ in lowest terms, the bulk far from the rotation axis is in the same thermal equilibrium state as nonrotating QCD at temperature $T/q$ and imaginary quark chemical potential $θ'=qθ+π(p+q+1)$; this follows from the Euclidean boundary conditions and locality alone, and holds nonperturbatively.
